rationale: Pivot from KAB (plateaued at 2-3/7 across last 8 train-mode sweeps) to anomaly_gated_histgb with the new day_abstain_q knob. Day-level abstention is the new dimension to sweep — train mode should explore q ∈ [0.0, 0.40] paired with gate_threshold ∈ [0.10, 0.40] to find the W5-breaking combination. Default 0.25 already gives 4/7 (matches KAB ceiling) without HP tuning; the upside lives in jointly tuning the two abstention quantiles.
